quotes.text: address-book-add-remote-carddav-description = Connect to a CardDAV address book

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The wording update puts LDAP before the local Address Book option and moves each option’s ID, icon and subview value together. The remote description uses CardDAV, and the new remote/LDAP Fluent IDs match their production consumers. Accepted subview definitions still distinguish ldapAccountSubview from localAddressBookSubview. This is scoped markup/localization wiring, not a rendered label, focus order or creation result.
title: Address Book option order keeps the LDAP and local subview contracts together
